Weeknight Lemon Butter Chicken

By Ruth Ellery · 12 March

I made this the week we moved and the kitchen was still in boxes, which is how it ended up being one pan and about six things. It has stayed one pan and six things ever since. Twenty-five minutes, most of which is the chicken doing nothing while you find a lemon.

You will need

  • 4 boneless chicken thighs
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • a knob of butter
  • 3 cloves garlic, thinly sliced
  • 1 lemon, half juiced and half sliced
  • 150 ml chicken stock
  • a handful of flat-leaf parsley, chopped
  • salt and pepper to taste

Method

  1. Pat the chicken dry and season both sides generously with salt and pepper.
  2. Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Brown the thighs skin-side down for 6 minutes, then turn and give them another 4.
  3. Lower the heat, add the butter and the garlic, and let it soften for a minute without colouring.
  4. Pour in the stock and the lemon juice, tuck the lemon slices around the chicken, and simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly.
  5. Scatter over the parsley and serve with anything that will mop up the sauce.

Serves 4.

Made this twice this week. The lemon slices are doing a lot of work.
